subject.title: Extract the exec-approval coordinator out of NodeAppModel (iOS)

question: Should this extraction and behavior-test conversion be folded into the open durable mobile approvals PR or scheduled as its immediate dependent follow-up?
rationale: Most requested code and all named source-guard tests exist only on the active stacked branch, so choosing the implementation base is a maintainer sequencing decision rather than a safe autonomous repair from current main.

options.title: Fold into the open PR
options.body: Refactor the state machine and replace the grep tests before the durable-approvals branch lands, preventing the temporary oversized model and brittle tests from reaching main.

options.title: Land then extract
options.body: Keep this issue as a required immediate follow-up and implement against the merged approval surface to reduce churn inside the already-large stacked PR.

recommendation.title: Fold into the open PR
recommendation.body: Refactor the state machine and replace the grep tests before the durable-approvals branch lands, preventing the temporary oversized model and brittle tests from reaching main.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active approval stack and the extraction issue, so they have the strongest context to choose the least disruptive branch boundary.
